name: Eventzilla
description: Eventzilla is an event registration and ticketing platform for creating event pages, selling tickets, collecting registrations, communicating with attendees, checking guests in and reporting on event performance.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Eventzilla application key through Railway's encrypted boundary, then let selected agents list one bounded event page or inspect one exact event without attendee, order or financial data.

credentialRequirements.name: EVENTZILLA_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Eventzilla API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create an application key under Eventzilla Settings > App Management and store it encrypted.

capabilities.label: Read event metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Eventzilla event summaries and inspect one exact event without people, orders or financial data.

allowed.label: List events
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five Eventzilla event summaries from offset zero.

allowed.label: Read an event
allowed.description: Read one exact Eventzilla event metadata summary.

blocked.label: Block people and financial data
blocked.description: Attendees, buyers, orders, transactions, questions, answers, barcodes, promo codes and payment details are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block event and registration mutations
blocked.description: Publishing, checkout, registration, order confirmation, attendee check-in and other writes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw API access
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, automatic pagination, bulk operations and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded event reads run directly; people, financial, registration, write, bulk and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; credential ownership, fixed origin, bounds and redaction still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed Eventzilla event reads and attaches the encrypted application key only to the fixed API origin.
Relay mounts two typed Eventzilla event reads and attaches the encrypted application key only to the fixed API origin.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates an application key under Eventzilla Settings > App Management, enters it in Relay, selects event-read capability and chooses Safe or Dangerous policy per agent install.

evidence.supports: Eventzilla documents HTTPS JSON API v2 at www.eventzillaapi.net, customer-created application x-api-key authentication, key disablement and offset/limit pagination.
Eventzilla documents list and exact-event reads under /api/v2/events, including event identifiers, titles, status, dates, timezone and event URL fields.
Eventzilla advertises its event-management API as a supported integration surface with documentation and support.
